basic_info.description:
Beautiful remodeled 2 bedroom plus office in trendy Mission!
This bright, renovated, freshly painted condo is ready for move in!
Located in the popular Mission District, this spacious property has 2 bedrooms plus a separate office.
The remodeled kitchen has stainless steel appliances, including an electric stove with hood, refrigerator and dishwasher. Lots of cabinets and counter space.
The large living room has built-in seating around windows bringing in lots of natural light.
The bathroom has a shower over the tub with newly renovated tile and vanity.
There is a shared roof deck.
A private balcony overlooks the vibrant neighborhood.
Cat 6 wiring is provided.
A parking space is available for $300/month. Storage is included in the rent.
Laundry room with coin washer and dryer provided.
Water, garbage and gas (for hot water) included in the rent.
Available now.
